evals.prompt: I have a fresh Vite + React + TypeScript project with react-hook-form, Radix UI, Axios, and @tanstack/react-query already installed. I want to set up robust error handling so my API errors display inline on forms, and I can easily switch to toast notifications without changing the form components. The project structure is: src/app/provider/index.tsx for the AppProvider, src/lib/axios/index.ts for Axios setup, and src/modules/auth/pages/login/components/login-form.tsx for the login form. Set up the complete error handling system for me.
evals.expected_output: All error handling files created (api-error.ts, strategies, alert system, notification layer, useErrorDisplay hook), key files modified (Axios interceptor, React Query types, AppProvider, forms), dependencies installed, TypeScript compiles without errors, and the system is ready to use with the login form wired as an example.

evals.prompt: After the error handling system is set up, I want to create a new form for 'create-order' that displays errors as toasts instead of inline. Walk me through how to: 1) add the form schema and hook, 2) wire the form with useErrorDisplay, 3) update the config to use toast mode, and 4) verify it compiles. Show me the exact code I need to write.
evals.expected_output: Clear code examples for: form component using useErrorDisplay('create-order'), updated error-display-config.ts entry with 'toast' mode, step-by-step walkthrough showing the form component doesn't need any conditional logic for the toast display. Demonstrates that changing display mode is config-only.

evals.prompt: I need to understand the error handling system I just set up. Show me: 1) what happens when a user submits a login form with wrong credentials (trace the error flow end-to-end), 2) how to add a new backend error code, 3) how to swap the Sonner toast library for a different one like notistack, and 4) how backend field errors get displayed on form fields.
evals.expected_output: Complete documentation explaining: the error flow from API rejection through strategy execution, adding new error codes (point to error-registry.ts), swapping toast libraries (create new adapter, change one line in AppProvider), and field error mapping (backend sends errors object, FormErrorStrategy calls setError for each field). References the generated docs.
